title: Cost of the Fourier estimation program
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $(H,C)$ be an outcome in the support of the probability distribution produced by the exact-degree Fourier estimation program on target $f$. Then its cost is $C=\bigl(|\mathcal F|m,\,0,\,|\mathcal F|m+|\mathcal F|m(n+1)\bigr)$, where $\mathcal F$ is the family of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $k$ and $m$ is the program's prescribed number of samples per subset.
hypotheses_covered: outcome belongs to the support of the program's run distribution
